title: Everyone Says Security Consolidation Saves Money. Four Organizations Did the Math
content_md: Ask a security vendor what a unified platform delivers, and you will hear about efficiency. Fewer consoles. Fewer agents. Fewer alerts to chase. The claim is reasonable; however, it has been repeated so often that it has become true in the way "exercise is good for you" is true. It is also about as useful when you are building a budget case. Article Link: Everyone Says Security Consolidation Saves Money. Four Organizations Did the Math
exclude_reason: Marketing/analysis piece on security consolidation savings. No security event, no vulnerability, no incident.
